verification.scoped_compilation: MSVC Win32 C++17 /W4 /WX /MD /fp:strict passed for both /Od and /O2 source; focused probe uses /Od /RTC1.
verification.numerical_scope: Three fixed matrices including identity, row pivot and precision-sensitive dense case; CW007F/027F; inverse+alias, plane transform+alias, six frustum planes with established finite FSQRT reference core; two RGBA cases across both runtime truncation modes including negative/large/NaN/infinity channels.
verification.native_reference: Isolated unchanged installed-PE function bytes relocated only at verified data/call references. CRT sqrt call uses explicit finite-core FSQRT boundary; no executable loading or game process interaction.
verification.device_probe: Passed actual D3D9StateCache nested guard depths, viewport borrowed identity/fields and attempted-call count, scissor byte exact value/re-read, zero Clear skip with null color, failed Clear counter, enabled command ordering, frustum count/later-record preservation, two selected clips, active append and pending restore, cached frustum skip.
verification.repository_build: scripts/build.ps1 after ghidra_export.py verify-seeds passed reconstructed_math and native_math_differential (2/2); primary owns new source CMake registration, so scoped compile is the new-source proof.

limitations: New typed interfaces are not native object layouts or drop-in ABI replacements.
One stable camera companion and one stable renderer companion must be retained; native global renderer replacement between command calls is not modeled.
Plane set count must not exceed16; transformed clip slots must remain below14 and actual D3D9 capabilities.
Finite nonnegative CRT square-root core reconstructed; exceptional CRT diagnostics remain open.
Original constructors, intrusive ambient/viewport wrappers and game validation remain outside this packet.
